videos.description:
Huff, puff, and a house that will not fall! Watch the classic fairy tale of The Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Wolf: one pig builds with straw, one with sticks and one with strong bricks. A gentle, colorful animated story in simple English for toddlers and preschoolers.
